delivered.body: Commercial Lease Agreement PARTIES. This Lease is between Calder Properties as Landlord and the Tenant. 1. PREMISES. The Landlord leases to the Tenant the premises at 400 Harbor Street. 2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay monthly Base Rent of USD 90,000, in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term. Rent for any partial calendar month shall be prorated by day. 3. TERM. The lease term is sixty months commencing on the Commencement Date. 4. ASSIGNMENT.
